title: Focus your attention on the third eye
caption:
Close your eyes and look, with both eyes, to the point between your eyebrows. Within moments, you will see your thoughts pass like clouds.

Technique 5 of 112. Focused at the third eye, you become the witness. Anger comes and goes, and you remain untouched.

Save this and try it for three minutes before sleep.

Technique and sutra from Osho, The Book of Secrets.
